basic_profile.bio: I'm a space sim enthusiast from Ontario, Canada, who loves diving into the vastness of games like Elite Dangerous. When I'm not charting the stars, you can find me hunting in the Ontario wilderness or exploring new music and holistic living concepts. I work as a software developer, which allows me to merge my love for technology with my passion for gaming. Typically, I'm online during evenings and weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship with a fellow gamer who shares my interests in both space and outdoor adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a background in computer science, I have a strong grasp of technology and enjoy applying this knowledge to gaming. I have self-taught myself many aspects of game mechanics, particularly those related to space simulators. I also have practical knowledge of outdoor survival and hunting, acquired through years of personal interest and experience.
